target.server_mode_note: The gateway runs in SERVER_MODE=development. In this mode MCPJungle performs no authentication and no ACLs: verifyUserAuthForAPIAccess and requireAdminUser both short-circuit, and checkAuthForMcpProxyAccess passes requests with no Authorization header. This was a deliberate, operator-authorised switch on 2026-10-23 to enable the Dashboard UI, recorded in noesis-ansible/inventory/mcpjungle-k8s/group_vars/all.yml. The trust boundary for the resulting open access is the tailnet itself. The mode is set once at first initialization and cannot be changed without a destructive database reset.
target.capture_method: Authenticated read-only GETs against the admin API (/api/v0/servers, /api/v0/server_configs, /api/v0/tool-groups) plus an MCP initialize + tools/list against the main /mcp endpoint. No tool was invoked.

server_configs_redacted.description: The richer admin view of each registered server. The upstream view includes bearer tokens, OAuth tokens and environment secrets, so every secret-bearing value is replaced with a non-reversible marker recording only its kind and length. This file cannot restore upstream credentials and is not a substitute for the Bitwarden escrow.
server_configs_redacted.redaction_policy: A value is replaced by <REDACTED:kind:len=N> where kind is one of opaque-token, jwt, hex-32, uuid. No secret material is recoverable from this file.

main_endpoint_tool_inventory.description: The main /mcp endpoint still serves all 308 tools. Creating tool groups does not narrow the main gateway; narrowing requires pointing a client at a group endpoint. The full per-tool metadata for this surface is maintained in config/mcpjungle/tool-inventory.json and is not duplicated here.

restore_procedure.servers: mcpjungle register -c <file> for each entry in main_gateway_servers. Note that upstream credentials are NOT recoverable from this backup: re-apply them from the Bitwarden escrow.
restore_procedure.groups: mcpjungle create group --conf config/mcpjungle/groups/<group-name>.json for any group absent from tool_groups. To update an existing group to its backed-up definition, use mcpjungle update group --conf <file>.
restore_procedure.ordering: Restore servers before groups: group creation validates every listed tool against the registry and fails if a tool does not exist or is disabled.

integrity.leak_check: Every non-trivial string value in the live server_configs was treated as a secret and checked against the emitted file. The emitted file contains none of them. Only field NAMES and the redacted shape markers survive.
integrity.note: This backup is a point-in-time snapshot. It records what the gateway looked like at captured_at and does not detect later drift. Re-capture and diff against main_gateway_servers and tool_groups to review drift.
